issues: A grey dashboard on a pale grey stage; in the wide shot nothing told you which card the camera would land on
In the wide shot the page was a thin sheet in empty space and the floor dots were too faint to give any sense of speed during the dive
After landing the hero card only got a light vignette, with no 'arrived' beat
12-sample motion blur ran for the whole shot, multi-rendering even the static frames, so renders were slow
changes: Lime look (graphite, neon yellow-green): a dark dashboard for a fictional running-club analytics product 'Tempo' where only the hero card (412 km this week) uses lime, so the target is obvious from above

The page hovers over a landing pad: a dot-grid floor with four landing rings centred on the hero that rush outward during the dive, and a lime hover glow under the page that tightens as it drops and becomes the card's rim light on touchdown
An FPV heading: one travel value drives pitch 62° to 0, scale 0.46 to 1.95, position and rotateZ −16° to 0, banking as it dives; 3% lift, a 26f ease-in dive covering 80%, then a 22f poly5 air-cushion
A landing payoff: the surroundings dim, the goal bar fills 0 to 82% in one stroke and a +18% badge pops with one overshoot, then a slow push-in
Motion blur only runs while the camera moves (8 samples) and static frames render once; the page is laid out at 2× so the close-up text is native resolution
